[D26:3] John: They asked me to be a programming mentor for game developers. I'll be teaching coding and assisting with projects. I'm really excited to share my knowledge and motivate people who are passionate about gaming.
[D26:4] James: Wow, John! Mentoring programmers to make games sounds awesome! You must love it. How do you feel about starting this journey?
[D26:5] John: I'm so excited and inspired! It's a great chance to help them and boost my own skills. I love sharing what I know and seeing others reach their potential - it's so rewarding!
[D26:6] James: It's so rewarding to see how much joy you get from it. Keep going, you're doing great!
[D26:7] John: Thanks, James! Your support really means a lot. It's so fulfilling to use my skills to make a difference. I hope this opens more opportunities for me.
[D26:8] James: I'm sure it will lead to great things. You got this! Oh, and I got this cool video card last week - I'm so excited to jump into it again!
[D26:8] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a computer case with a red light on it
[D26:9] John: Cool, James! What kind of games are you excited to play on it?
[D26:10] James:  I'm super into RPGs, so I'm excited about getting this video card and playing some new games. Have you heard any great things about Cyberpunk 2077? Do you think this game is worthy of my attention?
[D26:11] John: Yeah, I played it - it's awesome! Such an immersive world and an amazing story. I'm sure you'll love it!
[D26:12] James: I'm so excited for it! The world and story sound perfect. Thanks for recommending it, John!
[D26:13] John: No worries, James! Hope you have a blast playing. Let me know what you think!
[D26:14] James: Cool, John. Will do! Take care, see ya!
[D26:15] John: Take care! Enjoy that new computer. Later!
Session date: 2:14 pm on 13 October, 2022
[D27:1] John: Hey James! How's it going? I had a blast last week when my programmer friends and I organized an online comp. It was awesome to see everyone show off their skills! Anything new in your life?
[D27:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a desk with a laptop and a monitor
[D27:2] James: Hey John, congrats! Something cool happened to me recently. I made my first game and released it for the gaming community - it was so exciting!
[D27:2] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a game of thrones with a dragon and a dragon
[D27:3] John: Congrats on releasing your game, James! Was it fulfilling to see players engage with the game world you created?
[D27:4] James:  It was so fulfilling to see players engage with the game world I created. I'm really happy they're having fun with something I put so much work into.
[D27:5] John: So cool that people are enjoying it! What inspired you to create it?
[D27:6] James: Playing video games was always great, but creating my own game was really special. Witcher 3 gave me a ton of inspiration, with its amazing world and story. Plus, it pushed me to create something cool.
[D27:7] John: The Witcher 3 obviously had a huge impact on you. You must have put a ton of hard work and dedication into your game. Do you have any plans for future game development?
[D27:8] James: I put in so much effort and it paid off - now, I'm ready to make more games in different genres and test out new ideas. I'm pumped to see where this journey leads!
[D27:9] John:  I can't wait to see where your journey leads and the new creations you come up with. Your determination and love for game development is incredible. Keep going and you'll do great things!
[D27:10] James: I'm really looking forward to creating more enjoyable experiences!
[D27:11] John: I'm here for you. Anything you need, count on me!
[D27:12] James: Thanks, John! Your support is really appreciated.
[D27:13] John: No worries, James! We make a good team.
[D27:14] James: Yeah, totally. You've always been there for me, John. Thanks for having my back.
Session date: 7:36 pm on 21 October, 2022
[D28:1] James: Hey John, long time no talk! So much has happened!
[D28:2] John: Hey James! I'm excited to catch up. What's been up lately?
[D28:3] James: Three days ago my apartment lost power - so annoying because I had just gotten to the big reveal in that game! Had to wait hours before playing again.
[D28:4] John: Ugh, that stinks! Losing power in the middle of a game is such a bummer. Did it mess up your progress?
[D28:5] James: Oof, it definitely messed up my progress. I lost some of it because I forgot to save. Frustrating, but now I know to save more often!
[D28:6] John: Lesson learned - save progress! By the way, I organized the programming seminar last week.
[D28:7] James: Wow, cool! How did it go? Did you learn anything cool?

[D9:19] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a pizza with pineapples and ham on a wooden board

[D9:23] John: Got it, will check it out. Thanks!
[D9:24] James: Be sure to tell us your impressions when you try it! And Bon Appetit!
[D9:25] John: Thanks! Catch you later!
Session date: 12:45 am on 8 May, 2022
[D10:1] James: Hey John! Been a while since we chatted. Sorry 'bout not getting back sooner. How's it going? Any new games you're into?
[D10:2] John: Hey James! No worries, I know you are really busy at work. I'm good, thanks for asking. Oh, I've been organizing something with my friends yesterday - it was cool! Guess what it was, I'll give you a little hint.
[D10:2] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a wooden table with a game controller on it
[D10:3] James: Wow, John, that looks awesome! Is it an icon of a new game?
[D10:4] John: Nope, not a new game. We put together a tournament for our favorite game, CS:GO. Lots showed up and we made a bunch of money for charity!
[D10:5] James: Wow John, organizing that tournament for charity must have been a ton of effort, but it sounds like it was so worth it!
[D10:6] John: Definitely worth it! It took some planning and coordination, but seeing everyone come together for a good cause was so rewarding.
[D10:7] James: It must have been great to see the results of that effort. Have you considered organizing more events like that in the future?
[D10:8] John: Yeah, for sure! It was awesome and I want to do more events like that. It combines my interests and helps the community. Plus, it's great to get people together for some friendly competition.
[D10:9] James: Combining gaming and volunteering is a great idea! So fun and fulfilling. Where did you send the collected money?
[D10:10] John: Our main goal was to raise money for a dog shelter, which is not far from the street where I live. And we did it!
[D10:11] James: Helping animals is really important!
[D10:12] John: I agree. We still had some money left after helping the shelter, and we decided to use this money to buy groceries and cook some food for the homeless. They were very happy about it.
[D10:13] James: Glad you are helping those in need! You are doing a great job John, keep up the good work!
[D10:14] John: Thanks for your support, James! I won't stop there, I will do more and more good things!
[D10:15] James: I'm really proud of you!
Session date: 5:00 pm on 11 May, 2022
[D11:1] John: Hey James, it's been a bit since we last talked. Something cool happened recently - I volunteered my programming skills for a social cause. It was cool to use my passion to do something good. I made a software tool for one charitable foundation which helped streamline their operations and make them run more smoothly. Seeing my skills making a real difference in the world was really rewarding.
[D11:2] James: Hey John! Glad to hear from you. It's awesome that you used your skills to make a difference. Bet it was cool to see it in action. Would love to hear more about it!
[D11:3] John: Previously, this foundation used paper records and all inventory was recorded manually. I made an application that structured their work, and now everything they need for inventory is in one application on their smartphone.
[D11:4] James: Wow John, that's awesome! Must feel great to be part of something so important. I would love to see any visual examples of the impact your software made.
[D11:5] John: Yeah, here's a screenshot of the system. It'll make tracking inventory, resources, and donations run smoother and generate reports for analysis. Feels great knowing my skills are making a real difference to them.
[D11:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a computer monitor showing the cpu performance of a computer
[D11:6] James: Wow John, that's awesome! What motivated you to create such an amazing system for them?
[D11:7] John: I was inspired by their passion for helping kids, so I wanted to contribute in any way I could. Plus, coding lets me challenge myself and expand my skills, so this was a great chance to do both. It's really rewarding to use my coding skills to make a difference.
[D11:8] James: That's really great, John! It's awesome how you blended your passion with a good cause. How did it affect you?
[D11:9] John: It showed me the power of tech to make positive changes, beyond just my own enjoyment. It gave me a real sense of purpose.
[D11:10] James: Discovering our passions is truly rewarding. How do you think this experience will impact your future plans?
[D11:11] John: This experience has given me a clearer sense of purpose and motivated me to use my programming skills to make a positive impact. I'm now considering volunteer roles and potentially a career in the non-profit sector.
[D11:12] James: That's really inspiring. Have you found any non-profit organizations that align with your values and passion for programming?
[D11:13] John: I haven’t found it yet, but to be honest I haven’t looked for it. I think it won’t be difficult for me to find the organization I need.
[D11:14] James: There are lots of places where you can show off your skills! I'm sure you'll find one that's perfect for you in making a difference.
[D11:15] John: I'll be happy to find a place where my skills and passions are a perfect match. I'm hoping to make a positive impact there.
[D11:16] James: I'm sure you'll find the right spot, John. Your skills and passions will be a great addition. Good luck!
[D11:17] John: Thanks, your encouragement means a lot.
[D11:18] James: I'm here for you. Good luck!

Session date: 9:18 pm on 26 August, 2022
[D21:1] James: Hey John! Look how cute it is. My dog came to me today while I was playing on the console. What is new?
[D21:1] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a person holding a dog on a couch
[D21:2] John:  Your pup is so cute, remind me what's their name? I've been helping my younger siblings out with programming since they joined the programming course. It's really cool to see them get into it.
[D21:3] James:  His name's Ned and he's been awesome since I adopted him. I can't imagine life without him. It's great to hear that your siblings signed up for programming.
[D21:4] John: That's right, his name is Ned, how could I forget?!
[D21:5] James: Regarding your siblings, are you already working on anything cool with them?
[D21:6] John: Yeah! We're working on a cool project together that involves coding. It's a game and it's helping them learn.
[D21:7] James: Wow, learning and gaming sounds like a fantastic combination for coding education! Can you share more details about the game?
[D21:8] John: Yeah, they're playing a simple, text-based adventure game, working on their coding skills and having fun. I'm so proud of them! Maybe they'll even create their own video games, huh? Any new game designs on your mind?
[D21:9] James: Wow, sounds cool John! Learning coding with a text-based adventure game is impressive stuff. As for me, I've been trying out different genres of games and now I'm dying to create a strategy game like Civilization - love how complicated and in-depth they are. Fingers crossed, one day I'll make my own awesome strategy game!
[D21:10] John: Wow, James, that's impressive! It's gonna be awesome. Can't wait to see what you come up with!
[D21:11] James:  Are you free tomorrow?
[D21:12] John: Yes, tomorrow is my day off. Do you have any suggestions on how to spend tomorrow?
[D21:13] James: Yes, we can go to Starbucks for coffee if you want.
[D21:13] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a laptop computer with a colorful keyboard on a table

[D21:17] James: Of course, there are also light beers!
[D21:18] John: Great, then I agree! See you tomorrow at McGee's Pub!
[D21:19] James: See you John, bye!
Session date: 6:53 pm on 1 September, 2022
[D22:1] James: Hey John! Been a while, but hope you're doing well. My Unity strategy game is finally finished—it took loads of time and effort, but I'm really proud. Your support and encouragement made a real difference. Thanks for believing in me!
[D22:1] Image caption (automatic): a photography of a screenshot of a stone building with a giant creature
[D22:2] John: Hey James! Congrats on finishing your game! It looks amazing and I'm so proud of you for all the hard work you put in. Can I see more of it? Got any other screenshots to show me?
[D22:3] James: I appreciate your support. Check out this screenshot from it.
[D22:3] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a video game screen showing a person on a horse
[D22:4] John: This game looks great! What inspired you to create it?
[D22:5] James: I've always loved playing strategy games like Civilization and Total War, so I decided to challenge myself and create one of my own.
[D22:6] John: That's awesome! I love those games too. It must have been quite an experience making your own. Did you face any difficulties during development?
[D22:7] James: It was a bit challenging to get everything right, balancing mechanics and ensuring fairness. But with some trial and error, I managed to get it to where I wanted it.
[D22:8] John: Wow, that must have been a challenge, especially since you had to make sure the game was enjoyable and balanced. Congratulations on completing it! What were some key takeaways from the experience?
[D22:9] James: Thanks, John! It was definitely a learning experience. Perseverance and patience are key, and I'm proud of what I created after sticking with it. Also, feedback and collaboration are essential, and the help from others really made the game better. It was great!
[D22:10] John: Awesome that you learned those lessons! Collaboration and feedback make a huge impact on any project. I've been teaching my siblings coding. It's been a fulfilling experience and they're already creating their own programs - amazing!
[D22:11] James: Wow, John! Cool seeing others learn with your help. What kind of programs are they making?
[D22:12] John: They're starting small, making basic games and stories. It's inspiring how fast they learn and the good time they're having.
[D22:13] James: Wow! It's inspiring how fast they learn and the good time they're having. I bet they'll be creating their own complex projects soon!
[D22:14] John: I'm excited to see how far they can go! With their passion for video games like me, hopefully they can use those coding skills to make something cool. I'm so proud of them, can't wait to see what they come up with!
[D22:15] James: I'm proud of them too! Seeing the next generation pick up coding and making their own games is awesome. Can't wait to see what they create!
[D22:16] John: Thanks, James, for the support. I really appreciate it.
[D22:17] James: Yeah, you're the best! I'm here for you, no doubt.
[D22:18] John:  Your friendship really means a lot. I'm going through some difficult times now and it's really good to know I've got someone like you.
[D22:19] James: Just know I'm here if you need someone to talk or vent to. It might help alleviate some of the difficult times you're going through.
Session date: 9:23 pm on 4 September, 2022
[D23:1] James: Hey John, it's been a few days since we talked. So much has gone on, both good and bad. Yesterday, when we were at the theater, Samantha loves theater, I asked her to become my girlfriend, and she agreed. We have gone through a lot in this short period. My parents just started learning coding from me - it's been a learning experience, but I'm glad to help them out. It binds us a little closer. [D28:10] John: I gained insight into various programming approaches and techniques. It was interesting to hear other developers' ideas and strategies.
[D28:11] James: Learning new programming stuff is great. Did you find any ideas that you'll incorporate into your own work?
[D28:12] John: Yeah! Found some cool ideas that I can use in my own work. It's exciting to explore different programming techniques and how to implement them.
[D28:13] James: Cool, John! Broadening your programming skills and trying new techniques is great - keeps things exciting and helps you develop. Have you had a chance to try them out yet?

[D28:16] John:  I'll send you some resources and tutorials on the new programming approaches and techniques I learned. You'll find them cool!

[D28:19] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a man and woman in military clothing standing next to a dog
[D28:20] John: Cool. Mother's friend must still be in the army?
[D28:21] James: Yes, she is still serving. But she retired a long time ago. They used to tell me stories about their time in the military and their pup. Funny enough, I have a pic of me at their age playing on their old gaming setup. Would you like to see it?
[D28:22] John: Yeah, James! Show me that picture of you playing on their old gaming setup, it looks like a blast!
[D28:23] James: Here is a photo of this console with the game Mario. Funny gamepad, isn't it?
[D28:23] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a nintendo game console and a nintendo mario game controller
[D28:24] John: Oh yeah, that`s funny! Did you have fun with Nintendo when you were a kid?
[D28:25] James: Oh yeah! I had a blast with it when I was a kid. It was my first gaming system and I'd play Super Mario and The Legend of Zelda for hours. It totally sparked my passion for gaming.
[D28:26] John: Wow, James! Those games really sparked your passion for gaming, didn't they?
[D28:27] James: Those games introduced me to gaming and I've been hooked ever since. By the way, yesterday I tried Cyberpunk 2077. Great game, so addictive!
[D28:27] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a video game cover of the witcher wild hunt
[D28:28] John: I'm really glad you're enjoying this game. There will be so many unexpected turns in it, you can’t even imagine!
[D28:29] James: What do you think is the most difficult thing about this game?
[D28:30] John: The most difficult thing is to make the right choice. After all, even from the choice of lines in dialogues with characters, everything can go wrong. The choices here can be life-changing!
[D28:30] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a man in a leather vest and a belt
[D28:31] James: Thank you very much, I will definitely keep this in mind!
[D28:32] John: And remember, you don't have to be friends with every character in this game. I don't want to spoil it, but just remember this!
[D28:33] James: I'll definitely take your advice, John! Thank you for avoiding spoilers.
[D28:34] John: Always happy to help. Well, I have to go! Bye!
[D28:35] James: Take care, bye!

[D29:2] James: Hey John! Awesome job organizing a gaming tournament for a children's hospital! Combining gaming and a good cause - that's really cool! Tell me more about who helped out and what other games were played.
[D29:3] John: Thanks! We all pulled together for a great cause. My gaming pals and I also played Overwatch and Apex Legends. Everyone had a blast raising money for the kids' hospital. The atmosphere was awesome and everyone was so competitive. In the end, we raised a good amount. Feels good to use our love of gaming for good!
[D29:4] James: Wow, that sounds like a blast! It's great how gaming can bring people together like that. You made a huge difference in the kids' lives! Do you have any photos from the tournament?
[D29:5] John: I got a great shot at the tournament. Check it out! Everyone was so hyped, and it felt great knowing we were playing for a good cause.
[D29:5] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a computer screen with a game menu on it
[D29:6] James: Wow, this photo rocks!
[D29:7] John: Thanks! I'm glad you enjoyed it. It was a really awesome moment - unforgettable for all of us! What's new with you?
[D29:8] James: I actually have something new, Samantha and I have decided to move in together!
[D29:9] John: Wow, that's a really big decision! I hope you both have weighed the pros and cons. Where are you going to live?
[D29:10] James: Of course, this was a mutual and informed decision. We rented an apartment not far from McGee's bar.
[D29:11] John: You love spending time together in this bar, don't you?
[D29:12] James: We just love it! I’ll be honest, one of the criteria for our choice of apartment was this particular bar nearby.
[D29:13] John: Awesome, James! Excited to hear how it goes. Keep me posted and good luck!
[D29:14] James: Thanks, John! I'll be sure to keep you updated. I really appreciate your support. Take care!
[D29:15] John: No worries! I'm here for you whenever you need. Stay safe and chat soon!
[D29:16] James: Thanks! Appreciate your support. Stay safe and talk to you soon!
[D29:16] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a man and two dogs running in a field
Session date: 5:20 pm on 5 November, 2022
[D30:1] James: Hey John, hope you're doing well. Yesterday, we started on a road trip. It was fun spending time with the family and my dogs. Exploring new places and taking in nature with the furballs was awesome!
[D30:2] John: Hey James! Wow, what an adventure! Lately, I've been busy with something. Guess what? I had a great accomplishment this Tuesday! It was awesome.
[D30:3] James: That's great news. What did you do?
[D30:4] John: I won the regional chess tournament. It was intense but I came out on top!
[D30:5] James: That's awesome! Congrats! How did it feel to come out on top?
[D30:6] John: It felt so good. All my hard work and practice paid off and it was great to conquer the challenges. It gave me a huge confidence boost. So proud of myself!
[D30:7] James: Winning must have felt so good. What was it like when you won? What strategies did you use to get ready?
[D30:8] John: My strategy involved analyzing and anticipating my opponent's moves to stay one step ahead.

passages.text:
Session date: 5:07 pm on 16 June, 2022
[D14:12] John: Glad you're giving these books a try! I'm obsessed with the way they create a magical world you can escape into - plus the characters feel really real. By the way, what's the name of the dog in this picture from your Facebook? It`s so cute!
[D14:12] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dog sitting on a couch in a living room
[D14:13] James: This is Max – he's so lovable and playful. He brings me so much joy, especially in tough times.
[D14:13] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dog chewing on a shoe on a person's lap
[D14:14] John: Aww, he's adorable! I can tell Max brings you a lot of happiness. Pets are always such a great source of joy and love.
[D14:15] James: Yeah, Max is great - he always cheers me up when I'm feeling down. Enjoying those cuddles with him!
[D14:15] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dog standing in front of a pool
[D14:16] John: Does he enjoy swimming?
[D14:17] James: Yeah, he loves it! We usually hit the beach or lake, and he loves playing in the water. He's a pro swimmer!
[D14:18] John: Max must be having so much fun swimming and playing - it's the best!
[D14:19] James: He has a blast! Always a joy to see him so happy and carefree in his favorite activity.
[D14:20] John: He looks so happy - this is a great achievement of yours!
[D14:21] James: Thanks, John! I love making him happy.
[D14:21] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dog running in a field with a frisbee
[D14:22] John: Does Max have any special talents? He seems like quite the go-getter!
[D14:23] James: Max is a real go-getter! He's awesome at catching frisbees in mid-air - never misses!
[D14:23] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dog laying in the grass with a frisbee
[D14:24] John: Wow, Max loves playing fetch! Does he also enjoy long walks?
[D14:25] James: Yep! We love them; they're great exercise and give us fresh air. Here is a photo of us from a recent walk in the forest.
[D14:25] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a man walking a dog on a trail
[D14:26] John: Where's that spot where you could take a stroll? Bet Max loves all those hikes.
[D14:27] James: Max and I love taking walks on this nearby trail. It's a mile from my house. It's so tranquil and a great way to relax and connect with nature.
[D14:27] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dirt path in a field with trees
[D14:28] John: Wow, that looks awesome! Going for a nature walk is so refreshing, don't you think?
[D14:29] James: Yeah, John! It's so relaxing and refreshing. It helps me think straight and find my inner peace.
[D14:29] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a park with a bench and trees in the fall
[D14:30] John: That park is so peaceful. What do you do when you're there alone?
[D14:31] James: When I'm there, I usually bring a book and just chill. It's like an escape from reality.
[D14:32] John: Sounds great, James! Taking breaks and switching up the scenery is a great way to feel recharged. Keep it up.
[D14:33] James: Definitely! Taking breaks is important for recharging. Thanks for the support!
[D14:34] John: No problem, always here to have your back. Take care of yourself!
Session date: 9:59 pm on 19 June, 2022
[D15:1] James: Hey John, since our last chat, something awesome happened. Last Friday, I started introducing Max, Daisy and the new pup Ned. It was hard at first, but they're slowly adapting. It's sweet to watch them bond and have fun together.
[D15:2] John: Wow, that's cool, James! Seeing them bonding and having a great time is so sweet. Do you have a picture of them together?
[D15:3] James: Yep, I got a great pic last night. Check it out!
[D15:3] Image caption (automatic): a photography of three dogs in a field of grass with trees in the background
[D15:4] John: Wow, they look so cute! I can almost feel the love and joy in this photo. These last few days really got me thinking about my own future.
[D15:4] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a dog and a cat cuddling on a couch
[D15:5] James: What's been on your mind regarding the future?
[D15:6] John: Lately, I've been thinking about my career and where I want to be in the future. I'm driven and passionate, and I also want to make a positive impact on the world.
[D15:7] James: Gotcha, John. Finding a way to make a difference matters. Have you thought about any ideas on how to do that?
[D15:8] John: Yeah, I have. I've been looking into volunteering and thinking of going into non-profit work. I want to put my passions and abilities to use for causes I really care about.
[D15:9] James: Wow, John that sounds great! I'm sure with your skills and passion, you could do some really cool things with nonprofits. Here's a pic I took when I volunteered last month. It was really rewarding to see how little gifts can do so much!
[D15:9] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a group of people standing outside of a building
[D15:10] John: That's awesome, James! Was it cool to see the impact of the gifts? Can you tell me more about the organization you volunteered with?
[D15:11] James: It was great to see how much a simple act of kindness can mean to someone in need. I volunteered with an organization that provides necessary items to those who are less fortunate. It felt so rewarding to help, even if it was in a small way.
[D15:12] John: I think this is exactly what I need. Can you take me there this weekend?
[D15:12] Image caption (automatic): a photo of a young boy standing outside of a yellow building
[D15:13] James: Of course I can! I think there are still some of the previous staff there and I can even introduce you to them.
[D15:14] John: Thank you very much! Will there be some kind of interview required?
[D15:15] James: No, this is not necessary. All you need is to be a friendly and polite person, and also have a great desire to help people. I'm sure you will succeed!
[D15:16] John: Thanks for your support! I want to make this world a better place, and with your help I will definitely achieve my goal.
[D15:17] James: We can do this together!
[D15:18] John: Thanks, James. Your support means a lot to me. I'm determined to make a positive impact.
[D15:19] James: You got this! Stay focused on your dreams and don't give up.
Session date: 5:13 pm on 9 July, 2022
[D16:1] James: Hey John! Long time no talk - hope you're doing well. Guess what? Last week I actually won an online gaming tournament! It was such an exciting experience and it blew my mind when I won. Winning felt so good and it really motivated me to keep improving.
[D16:2] John: Hey James! Congrats on winning the online gaming tournament! It's super fulfilling to see your hard work pay off. So happy for you!
[D16:3] James: Thanks! It was really fulfilling to see my hard work pay off with a victory in the tournament. How are you?
[D16:4] John: Feeling the tug of emotion lately. Determined and passionate on one hand, but feeling overwhelmed and stressed on the other. Balancing personal and professional is kind of a challenge. How have you been?
[D16:5] James: Yeah, staying balanced can be tough. I'm trying to take breaks from my hobbies and do other things. Lately I've become interested in extreme sports. Yesterday, for example, I was doing rope jumping. The highest height I jumped from was 150 meters!
[D16:6] John: Wow, how cool! What other extreme sport have you tried?
